findings.rule: Title block heat treatment field must not be blank when a heat treatment note is specified on the drawing.
findings.reasoning: The title block heat_treatment field is '---' while note N1 explicitly requires case hardening to 55–60 HRC with a 0.8–2 mm case depth. A manufacturer reading only the title block will ship the part unhardened, causing functional failure of this wear-critical sleeve.
findings.correction: Update the title block heat_treatment field to reference N1 or state 'Case Hardened 55-60 HRC per Note N1'.

findings.rule: External threads running into a shoulder require an undercut or relief groove so the thread can be fully formed and a mating nut/face can seat flush.
findings.reasoning: Feature F7 describes an external M20 thread running up to the shoulder with no undercut or relief groove. Without a thread-relief groove the thread cannot be cut completely to the shoulder, preventing proper assembly and risking cross-threading or incomplete engagement.
findings.correction: Add a thread-undercut (relief groove) dimension at the shoulder adjacent to the M20 thread per standard practice (e.g., DIN 76-1).

findings.rule: Functional outer diameters on a mating sleeve require a tolerance or fit class to control assembly.
findings.reasoning: Dimensions D1 and D13 define the ⌀30 outer cylindrical surface (F1) of a pin sleeve but carry no tolerance. Relying on the general machining tolerance of ±0.5 mm (for the 6–30 mm range) is far too loose for a sleeve that must locate or slide-fit into a housing.
findings.correction: Assign an appropriate tolerance or fit class (e.g., h6, h7) to the ⌀30 outer diameter dimensions D1/D13.

findings.rule: Functional inner bores on a sleeve require a tolerance or fit class to control the pin/sleeve interface.
findings.reasoning: Dimensions D4 and D12 define the ⌀20 inner bore (F2) but have no tolerance. Unlike the ⌀12 bore (D3) which correctly specifies H7, this bore is left to the general tolerance, which is unacceptable for a functional sliding or locating fit.
findings.correction: Assign an appropriate tolerance or fit class (e.g., H7) to the ⌀20 bore dimensions D4/D12.

findings.rule: All notes on a released engineering drawing must convey valid technical information.
findings.reasoning: Note N5 contains the text 'YFYFGHYFGHGF', which is gibberish/placeholder text. Leaving invalid notes on a production drawing creates confusion and indicates the drawing was not properly reviewed before release.
findings.correction: Delete note N5 or replace it with the intended technical content.
